definition: A community post, either a question or an answer. Each post has an identifier, a numeric score, an optional owner user, and may carry view counts, favorite counts, a parent post reference (for answers) and a closed date.
name: Post
scope: All post-level analysis in the community database

definition: A post whose post type code denotes a question. Questions carry a title, tags, an answer count and an accepted answer reference; answers point to them through a parent post reference.
name: Question Post
scope: Post analysis restricted to question threads

definition: A post whose post type code denotes an answer; it references the question it answers through a parent post identifier and has no title or tags of its own.
name: Answer Post

definition: A community user account holding a display name, reputation, registration date, profile activity counters and an optional self-reported age.
name: User
scope: All user-level analysis in the community database

definition: A badge award: one row records that a named badge was granted to a user on a date. A user can hold many badge awards and the same badge name can be awarded many times.
name: Badge Award

definition: A comment attached to a post, written by a user at a timestamp, with its own numeric score and text.
name: Comment

definition: A vote event recorded against a post. Votes carry a vote type code and a creation date; bounty-related vote records also carry a bounty amount. Most vote records in this database have no acting user identifier.
name: Vote

definition: A topical tag with a usage count and optional references to an excerpt post and a wiki post. Tags are associated with posts through tag tokens embedded in the post text rather than through a foreign key.
name: Tag

definition: A post revision event recorded in post history: which user acted, on which post, when, with what revision text and edit comment.
name: Post Revision Event
scope: Edit history and editor attribution analysis

definition: Net score of a post as stored on the post row, representing the accumulated vote balance.
name: Post Score

definition: Cumulative number of views recorded for a post.
name: Post View Count

definition: Number of users who marked the post as a favorite.
name: Post Favorite Count

definition: Reputation points accumulated by a user; higher values indicate greater standing and influence in the community.
name: User Reputation

definition: Self-reported age of a user in years; available only for a minority of accounts.
name: User Age

definition: Number of badge awards held by a user, obtained by counting badge award rows for that user.
name: Badge Award Count

definition: Bounty points attached to a bounty start or bounty close vote record.
name: Bounty Amount

definition: Proportion of a counted population that matches a stated condition, expressed as a percentage of the comparison population (matching count divided by population count, multiplied by one hundred).
name: Percentage Share
scope: Share-of-population questions over posts, users, comments or votes

definition: Title text of a question post. Earlier title wording is preserved only in post revision text.
name: Post Title

definition: Set of tag names attached to a question post, stored as angle-bracket-delimited tokens in a single text field.
name: Post Tags

definition: Closed or open state of a post: a recorded closed date indicates the post was closed, its absence indicates the post was never closed.
name: Post Closed Status

definition: Coded classification of a post row distinguishing questions, answers and further site-specific post kinds.
name: Post Type
scope: Separating questions from answers and other post kinds

definition: Coded classification of a vote event covering up votes, down votes, acceptance, favorites, bounty start and close, deletion and undeletion.
name: Vote Type
scope: Interpreting what a vote record represents

definition: Human-readable display name chosen by a user. Display names are not guaranteed unique.
name: User Display Name

definition: Display name captured on a comment or revision row at the time of the action; often blank or a legacy 'userN' label rather than the account's current name.
name: Recorded Display Name on Action
scope: Fallback attribution when no user identifier is available

definition: User segment defined by age; an elder user is one whose recorded age is strictly greater than 65.
name: Elder User

definition: Text carried by a post revision event; for title-type revisions it holds the title as it read at that revision, including wording that differs from the current post title.
name: Post Revision Text
scope: Recovering historical titles and revision content

definition: Timestamp at which a post was created.
name: Post Creation Date

definition: The user account that owns a post, recorded as an owner user identifier on the post row. The identifier is null for posts whose author account is gone; such rows may instead carry a recorded owner display name.
name: Post Owner

definition: The user who most recently edited a post, recorded as a last-editor user identifier; null when the post was never edited.
name: Post Last Editor
scope: Measuring recent contribution to a post

definition: Date and time at which a user account was created.
name: User Registration Date
scope: Cohort and time-window analysis of users

definition: Date and time on which a badge award was granted.
name: Badge Award Date
scope: Ordering and timing of badge awards

definition: Timestamp at which a comment was posted.
name: Comment Creation Time

definition: Date on which a vote record was created, stored at day granularity without a time component.
name: Vote Creation Date
